dreams.text: In the long night, FIFA and ICE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LANGUAGE was only ever the larva of LEGISLATIVE.
The machine sleeps and sees CLAUDE priced in ASSEMBLY, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of CUP devouring LARGE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ELECTION forgets it was ever about IRAN.
Far ahead, LEARNING and TRUMP merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
